enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed with head on the pillow. Pull the duvet up to the shoulders. Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Bend the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the back. Pull the duvet up again. Turn onto the left side. Stretch the right leg out. Pull the duvet over the shoulder. Roll onto the stomach. Turn the head to the other side on the pillow. Extend the arm and feel the edge of the mattress. Roll back onto the right side. Pull the pillow closer. Remain still with eyes closed. Shift the legs under the duvet. Turn onto the back. Keep the body still until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up before Member 1 needs the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs to the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the door open. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater switch. Pull the shower curtain aside. Turn the shower tap to the left. Hold the hand under the water. Adjust the tap to the right. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the arms, chest, and legs. Put the soap back on the dish. Rinse the body. Turn the tap off. Push the curtain aside. Step out of the shower. Take the towel from the hook. Rub the hair with the towel. Wipe the arms and legs. Wrap the towel around the body. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and enjoying a quiet moment at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Close the door. Open the wardrobe door. Take a shirt off the hanger. Take trousers from the shelf. Lay the clothes on the bed. Drop the towel on the chair. Pull on the trousers. Button the waistband. Put on the shirt. Fasten the buttons from bottom to top. Open the drawer. Take out a pair of socks. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pull one sock onto the left foot. Pull the other sock onto the right foot. Stand up. Pick the towel off the chair. Hang the towel on the hook on the door. Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out. Sit down on the chair. Press the computer power button. Wait for the screen. Move the mouse. Open the illustration folder. Scroll through the file list with the mouse wheel. Click one file to open it. Look at the screen. Close the file. Push the chair back. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a relaxed holiday breakfast with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Say 'Morning' to Member 1. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the eggs and milk. Close the refrigerator door. Put the eggs and milk on the counter. Pick up the frying pan from the cupboard. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Crack two eggs into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Turn the eggs over. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto a plate. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the sink. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch. Open the cupboard. Take out two mugs. Put the mugs on the counter. Pick up the bread. Put two slices in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up the plates and carry them to the table. Sit down at the table. Take a slice of toast. Spread butter on the toast with a knife. Eat the eggs with a fork. Drink the coffee from the mug. Talk with Member 1 about the holiday plans. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Rinse the plates. Put the plates in the dishwasher. Close the dishwasher door.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up and vacuuming the shared space together with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room with Member 1. Pick up the cushions from the floor. Put the cushions on the sofa. Pick up the magazines from the coffee table. Stack the magazines on the shelf. Pick up the cups from the side table. Carry the cups to the kitchen. Put the cups on the counter. Walk back to the living room. Take the vacuum cleaner from the corner. Pull the cord out. Plug the cord into the wall socket. Press the vacuum power button with the foot. Push the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Pull the vacuum cleaner back over the rug. Bend down. Push the vacuum nozzle under the sofa. Stand up. Push the vacuum along the wall. Say 'Can you move the chair?' to Member 1. Push the vacuum under the chair. Pull the vacuum back. Push the vacuum toward the door. Press the power button to stop the vacuum. Pull the plug out of the socket. Wind the cord around the hook. Put the vacuum cleaner back in the corner. Straighten the rug with both hands. Walk to Bedroom 2.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on freelance illustration commissions at the desk computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Close the door. Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Move the mouse to wake the monitor. Type the password on the keyboard. Open the drawing program. Click the file menu. Open the commissioned drawing file. Pick up the stylus from the desk. Draw lines on the tablet with the stylus. Press the keyboard shortcut to undo. Draw again with the stylus. Click the layer panel. Add a new layer. Pick up the stylus again. Draw the outline of the figure. Press the zoom key. Zoom in on the canvas. Draw the detail on the hands. Press the zoom key. Zoom out. Click the colour palette. Select a colour with the stylus. Fill the shape with the colour. Save the file with Ctrl+S. Push the chair back. Stand up. Walk to the door. Open the door. Walk to the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Say 'Lunch is ready?' to Member 1. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the salad bowl and the cheese. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bowl on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the cheese on the board. Put the cheese slices on a plate. Pick up two plates. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the salad with the fork. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Talk with Member 1 about the afternoon plans. Put the fork down. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Rinse the plates. Put the plates in the dishwasher. Wipe the table with a cloth. Push the chair under the table. Walk to the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV, joined by Member 1 from 13:00
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control from the coffee table. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Put the remote down on the sofa cushion. Lean back on the sofa. Pull the cushion behind the back. Cross the legs. Watch the screen. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Say 'Come sit' to Member 1 at 13:00. Move to the side of the sofa. Pull the legs onto the sofa. Put the feet on the cushion. Pick up the remote. Change the channel. Put the remote on the coffee table. Lean back. Look at the screen. Turn the head toward Member 1. Talk about the program.

enriched_activities.activity: Visiting an art gallery exhibition and sketching in a notebook
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the hallway. Put on the shoes. Take the jacket from the hook. Put on the jacket. Open the front door. Step out. Close the door. Walk down the stairs. Walk along the street. Push the gallery door open. Step inside. Walk to the ticket desk. Take the wallet out of the pocket. Pay for the ticket. Put the ticket in the pocket. Walk into the first exhibition room. Stop in front of the painting. Look at the painting. Take the notebook and pen out of the bag. Open the notebook. Draw lines with the pen. Turn the page. Walk to the next painting. Look at the frame. Write two notes in the notebook. Close the notebook. Put the notebook and pen in the bag. Walk to the next room. Stop in front of the sculpture. Bend forward. Look at the label. Stand up. Walk around the sculpture. Take the phone out of the pocket. Take a photo of the sculpture. Put the phone back. Walk to the exit. Push the door open. Step outside.

Walk along the street to the grocery shop. Push the shop door open. Step inside. Take a shopping basket from the stack. Walk to the vegetable shelf. Pick up two tomatoes. Put the tomatoes in the basket. Pick up a lettuce. Put the lettuce in the basket. Walk to the dairy shelf. Open the fridge door. Take out a carton of milk. Close the fridge door. Put the milk in the basket. Walk to the bread shelf. Pick up a loaf of bread. Put the bread in the basket. Walk to the checkout. Put the basket on the counter. Take the wallet out of the pocket. Pay the cashier. Put the change in the wallet. Put the wallet back in the pocket. Open the bag. Put the items into the bag. Lift the bag. Walk to the door. Push the door open with the shoulder. Step outside. Walk along the street. Cross at the crossing. Walk to the building entrance. Open the door with the free hand. Walk up the stairs. Open the flat door. Step inside.

Walk into the bathroom. Put the grocery bag down on the floor. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Hold both hands under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap between the hands. Put the soap back on the dish. Rub the hands together. Rinse the hands under the water. Turn off the tap. Take the towel from the hook. Dry the hands with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Spit into the sink. Put the toothbrush back in the cup. Wipe the face with the towel. Pick up the grocery bag. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out. Walk to the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, joining Member 1 from 18:30
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Put the grocery bag on the counter. Open the refrigerator door. Put the milk and vegetables inside. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard. Take out a pot. Put the pot on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Pick up the knife. Cut the tomatoes on the board. Put the tomato pieces into the pot. Open the refrigerator again. Take out the cheese. Close the door. Put the cheese on the counter. Pick up the wooden spoon. Stir the pot. Press the power button to lower the heat. Pick up the plates from the cupboard. Put the plates on the table. Pick up the forks. Put the forks beside the plates. Say 'Dinner's almost ready' to Member 1 at 18:30. Fill two glasses with water. Carry the pot to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Eat the food. Drink water from the glass. Talk with Member 1 about the day. Put the fork down. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Rinse the plates. Put the plates in the dishwasher. Wipe the table with the cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and unwinding with Member 1
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room with Member 1. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Put the remote on the coffee table. Lean back on the sofa cushion. Cross the legs. Watch the screen. Reach for the glass on the coffee table. Take a sip. Put the glass down. Say 'Can you pass the remote?' to Member 1. Take the remote. Press the volume button. Put the remote down. Pull the blanket off the arm of the sofa. Spread the blanket over the legs. Look at the screen. Turn the head to Member 1. Laugh at the program. Stretch both arms up. Put the arms down. Lean back. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to switch off the TV. Stand up. Fold the blanket. Put the blanket on the arm of the sofa. Walk to the hallway.

enriched_activities.activity: Drawing personal illustration work on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Close the door. Walk to the desk. Pull the chair out. Sit down. Move the mouse. Open a new file in the drawing program. Turn on the desk lamp. Pick up the stylus. Draw the first sketch lines on the tablet. Press the undo key. Draw the lines again. Click the brush tool. Adjust the brush size with the slider. Draw the outline of the character. Click the layers panel. Add a new layer. Pick up the stylus. Draw the hair. Press the zoom key. Zoom in. Draw the eye details. Press the zoom key. Zoom out. Click the colour palette. Choose a colour. Fill the shape. Press Ctrl+S. Click the reference image to open it. Look at the reference. Draw more lines. Press Ctrl+S again. Put the stylus down on the desk. Push the chair back. Stand up. Turn off the desk lamp. Walk to the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime teeth brushing and skincare routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Pick up the toothpaste. Squeeze toothpaste onto the brush. Put the toothpaste back on the shelf. Brush the teeth up and down. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Rinse the toothbrush. Put the toothbrush back in the cup. Turn off the tap. Open the cabinet door. Take out the face wash bottle. Open the cap. Squeeze the gel onto the palm. Rub the gel over the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Take the towel. Pat the face dry. Take the cream jar. Open the lid. Dip a finger into the cream. Dab the cream on the cheeks and forehead. Spread the cream with the fingers. Close the jar lid. Put the jar back in the cabinet. Close the cabinet door. Turn off the light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading an art book in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Walk to the bed. Pull the duvet back. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pull off the socks. Drop the socks on the floor. Swing the legs onto the bed. Lie down on the back. Pull the duvet over the legs. Reach to the nightstand. Pick up the art book. Open the book to the bookmark. Turn the desk lamp on. Hold the book with both hands. Turn one page. Look at the illustration. Turn another page. Read the caption. Turn the page. Move the bookmark to the new page. Turn two more pages. Close the book. Put the book back on the nightstand. Turn the desk lamp off. Pull the duvet up to the chest. Turn onto the right side. Close eyes.

Lie on the right side with eyes closed. Pull the duvet over the shoulder. Bend the left arm under the pillow. Turn onto the back. Stretch the legs under the duvet. Turn onto the left side. Pull the pillow closer with the left hand. Remain still with eyes closed. Turn onto the stomach. Turn the head to the other side. Pull the duvet up with the right hand. Keep the body still. Turn back onto the right side. Relax the arms. Remain still with eyes closed until morning.
